messages:
alex: opening thread for the 03:20 UTC cross-region route-churn + TLS failures. saw a burst of client retries and 5xxs peaking around 03:22. logging this for owners/action items.
rachel: alerted oncall at 03:23. control-plane shows a rapid route update sweep at 03:19 which lines up with the start of failures.
tom: capture: several `handshake_failure` entries and `x509: certificate is valid for svc-edge, not api.redwood.example` from a subset of responses. looks like traffic hit an outdated edge pool with stale certs.
nina: quick mitigation done at 03:30: pinned cross-region egress to stable pool, drained suspect pool, and forced cert reloads. metrics normalized by 03:45.
alex: root-cause hypothesis: an automated rollout truncated by a concurrent control-plane reconcile led to a transient routing mapping to a legacy pool that still had old template/cert; SDK retries amplified apparent impact.
rachel: triage action items (owner / ETA):
  - tom -> remove legacy pool IDs from routing configs and add deny rule in control-plane (ETA 2026-04-05)
  - ina -> add SNI/cert post-rollout probe to control-plane job and fail gate on mismatches (ETA 2026-03-30)
  - alex -> update runbook with explicit "pin/drain/reload" checklist and include smoke-check commands (ETA 2026-03-27)
  - rachel -> create telemetry alert for SNI-thumbprint mismatch >=0.3% for >4m (ETA 2026-03-26)
  - ops-bot -> create tracking ticket RH-4102 and schedule a recurrence review (ETA immediate)
ops-bot: created ticket RH-4102 (internal/rh/4102) assigned to tom,ina,alex,rachel. status=open.
tom: plan: will split RH-4102 into RH-4102a (routing cleanup) and RH-4102b (control-plane probe). I'll open PRs and link.
nina: smoke snippet for probe (will PR):
```
openssl s_client -connect edge-eu:443 -servername api.redwood.example -brief
```
alex: additional long-term mitigations:
  - short-term client jitter cap on retries during cross-region errors
  - tie route-change events to a post-deploy TLS validation probe before global promotion
  - track recurring incidents in monthly reliability board and escalate if > 3 events in 90 days
rachel: scheduling a 30m sync Thurs 10:00 UTC to split tickets and review PRs. invite will include runbook diff.
tom: please prefix updates in this thread with "RH-4102" so ops-bot annotates. I'll post RH-4102a PR link once ready.
ops-bot: RH-4102 status=open; next_check=2026-03-26T12:00:00Z.
deploy-bot: noted: last deploy touching edge template was 03:15 UTC, no pipeline errors.
